about: The shake roof's hand-made pieces (D251, D258, tools/kits): its own modules over the roof pattern's (D290), laid along the roof's lines, each modelled along +X, Y up from what it sits on, Z across, in metres. The covering is about 0.03 m of split pine shakes (shakes.ron). Its rafters and battens are the pattern's. Its ridge cap is anchored at the middle of its foot, seated on the covering.

ridge.about: A ridge cap of two weathered pine boards, one lapping the other, nailed, modelled; unfolded flat so it drapes over a ridge or a hip.
